headlines.title: Iran issues new demands over Strait of Hormuz
headlines.description: Iran on Saturday issued a new list of demands to the United States, complicating efforts to reopen the critical Strait of Hormuz. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports from Doha.

headlines.title: Hunter Biden says Joe Biden’s cancer has spread
headlines.description: In a new interview, Hunter Biden gave an update on his father’s cancer battle, revealing that former President Biden’s prostate cancer has spread further. NBC News’ Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Perez Hilton hospitalized in ‘serious but stable’ condition, family says
headlines.description: Perez Hilton was in serious condition Saturday at a Florida hospital after he livestreamed what appeared to be self-harm from his Miami-area home Tuesday night, his family said in a statement.

headlines.title: Louisiana warns against flesh-eating bacteria after five deaths
headlines.description: Louisiana health officials are urging residents to take precautions against a flesh-eating bacterial infection following the deaths of five people this year.

headlines.title: Delta passengers evacuated by slide after emergency landing in Atlanta
headlines.description: Passengers aboard an Orlando-bound Delta flight had to evacuate via slide after the aircraft made an emergency landing on a taxiway at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport shortly after takeoff Saturday morning.

headlines.title: Hunter Biden says Joe Biden’s cancer has spread
headlines.description: Former President Joe Biden’s son, Hunter Biden, said that his father’s cancer is spreading in what he described as a “very debilitating.”

headlines.title: Naked college swimmer killed security guard before fleeing on foot in Maui, police say
headlines.description: A college athlete was arrested Thursday and accused of killing a 63-year-old security guard after police found him wandering naked through the streets of Maui.

headlines.title: Jorge Messi, father of soccer legend Lionel Messi, dies at age 68
headlines.description: Jorge Messi, a constant presence in the stands at his son Lionel Messi’s matches, has died at age 68 after an illness, according to a statement from the clinic that treated him.

headlines.title: Misdemeanor gun charge against James Harden dismissed by Texas judge
headlines.description: A misdemeanor gun charge against All-Star Cleveland Cavaliers guard James Harden in Texas has been dismissed after he completed an alternative resolution program allowing him to avoid a criminal record, court records show.

headlines.title: Where to find NIOSH-approved N95 masks right now
headlines.description: NIOSH-approved N95 respirators are the most protective type of face mask, according to the CDC. Doctors explain how to shop for them.

headlines.title: The best dog food for growing puppies
headlines.description: Veterinarians share the best puppy food to support healthy growth and development. Shop options from trusted brands like Purina, Royal Canin and Hill’s.
